description: Use this tool to interact with files stored in FilesAnywhere through natural language queries. It enables users to search, summarize, compare, and extract information from documents without manually reviewing each file. This tool is appropriate when working with stored documents to quickly locate key details, analyze content, or generate insights directly from file data.
